title: Check availability of an association name
summary: Check the availability of an association name online to ensure your proposed name is not already registered or reserved.
intro:
When you choose a name for your association, it must not be identical or similar to a name that is already registered for:

You can check the availability of a name online.

The online search results will indicate whether your proposed name is already registered or reserved.
who_can_apply: Anyone who wants to search the availability of an association name.

how_to_steps.text: Enter the association name you want to search.
Select 'Check Now' to view the search results.

faqs.q: Who can check the availability of an association name?
faqs.a: Anyone can check the availability of an association name.

faqs.q: What do I need to check an association name?
faqs.a: You need your chosen association name(s).

faqs.q: How do I check if an association name is available?
faqs.a: Select the 'Check online' button, enter the association name you want to search, and select 'Check Now' to view the search results.
